name: Viet Spice
kurzbeschreibung:
**Discover Viet Spice in Tirol**

Welcome to a unique culinary adventure in the heart of the Alps! **Viet Spice in Tirol** brings the vibrant flavors of Vietnam to the picturesque landscapes of **Tirol**. Indulge in a fusion of exotic spices and traditional Austrian hospitality in our cozy restaurant nestled near **Innsbruck**.

### **Our Menu Highlights**
Savor authentic Vietnamese dishes with a **Tiroler** twist—think **Pho** with a side of **Kaiserschmarrn**, or fresh **Bánh Mì** sandwiches paired with crisp **Tiroler** beers. Our menu is a harmonious blend of **Südostasien** and Alpine comfort food.

### **Why Visit Us?**
- **Authentic & Fresh**: Only the finest ingredients, sourced locally and from Vietnam.
- **Warm Atmosphere**: A welcoming space where you can enjoy your meal with a view of the **Nordkette** or the charming streets of **Innsbruck**.
- **Unique Experience**: A taste of the world in the middle of the **Alpen**.

### **Location & Opening Hours**
Find us in the heart of **Innsbruck**, just a short walk from the **Goldenes Dachl**. Open daily from **11:00 AM to 10:00 PM**—come by for lunch, dinner, or a relaxing coffee break with a Vietnamese twist.

**Prost & Chào mừng!** 🍜⛰️
